items.text: nahi abhi
delay ho raha hai
mujhe paise nahi hai

items.context: Kya aap abhi payment kar sakte hain?
items.text: kya abhi payment kar payenge
thoda waqt chahiye

items.context: Kab tak aapki payment possible hogi?
items.text: mujhe samay chahiye
mera naukri chala gaya abhi paise nahi hai
main beemaar hoon isliye payment nahi kar pa raha
agar thoda waqt mil jaaye to paisa de dunga
mera address delhi mein hai aur mai unemployed hoon
kiraye ke liye bhi paise kam pad rahe hain is waqt
meri tabiyat kharab hai is wajah se delay ho raha
doctor ne kaha hai thik hone mein thoda waqt lagega

items.context: Kya aap apne system se payment kar pa rahe hain?
items.text: mai aapke system se pay kar pa raha nahi hoon

items.context: Kya aapke paas kaam abhi hai payment ke liye?
items.text: job chala gaya hai isliye payment abhi mumkin nahi

items.context: Kya aapne koi financial support lene ki koshish ki hai?
items.text: maine apply bhi kiya tha loan ke liye par reject ho gaya

items.context: Kya aap physically fit hai payment karne ke liye?
items.text: main kal se beemaar hoon doctor ke pass hoon abhi bhi

items.context: Aapka current location kya hai payment ke liye?
items.text: main Gurgaon se hoon paise bhejne mein problem aa rahi hai
mera office band ho gaya hai aur mera income source khatam ho gaya hai isliye abhi payment nahi kar sakta
mai kuch mahino se beemaar hoon doctor ne kaha hai rest lena zaroori hai aur is wajah se paisa nahi bhej pa raha
pichle mahine mera accident ho gaya tha us wajah se hospital ke kharche badh gaye aur abhi paise nahi hai payment karne ke liye

items.context: Aap ki current financial situation kya hai payment ke liye?
items.text: mujhe thodi madad chahiye kyuki meri naukri chali gayi hai main payment abhi turant nahi kar sakta

items.context: Kya aapke paas koi medical certificate ya documents hai?
items.text: main Aligarh me rehta hoon aur meri health problem ki wajah se main apni salary nahi le pa raha hu

items.context: Kya aap thoda aur time le sakte hain payment ke liye?
items.text: meri tabiyat bahut kharab thi isliye main apni salary lene ka kaam nahi kar paya abhi payment mein thodi der rahegi

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: financial_hardship - explains they cannot pay right now because of job loss, illness or similar
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
